incidents.name: BankrollNetworkStack buyFor dividend inflation
incidents.notes: buyFor() accepts an arbitrary beneficiary and was called ~2810 times with the pool contract itself as the buyer, inflating the Solidity 0.6.8 unchecked dividend accounting so a single flash-loaned buy/sell/withdraw round trip drained the WBNB reserve.

sources.ref: onchain review: BankrollNetworkStack 0x564d4126... created by 0xcb71eb21f53a2f4de0f26dc90518df10be13d1ec on 2021-03-10, no upgrade events; distinct contract from the 2025 BankrollStack rows (bsc 0x16d0a151..., ethereum 0x7b3611b0...)

incidents.name: BankrollNetworkStack donatePool dividend inflation
incidents.notes: donatePool() credits the donated WBNB to shareholders immediately and the same transaction can buy in and sell out, so a flash-loaned donate -> buy -> sell -> withdraw cycle returned more WBNB than it consumed.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xAdEfb902CaB716B8043c5231ae9A50b8b4eE7c4e created 2021-07-07T22:51:29Z by 0xcb71eb21f53a2f4de0f26dc90518df10be13d1ec, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x2dea406bb3bea68d6be8d9ef0071fdf63082fb52; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). 24.5 WBNB x $645.43/BNB at the incident timestamp 1750317290 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $15,813.
